snippet.title: Hungry Chicks - Battle Farm | Gameplay PC | Steam | GandaCu
snippet.description:
Welcome to Hungry Chicks – Battle Farm!
The peace on your farm is over – hungry enemies are after your food! But your chicks won’t give up without a fight: starting from the barn, they charge into battle, wave after wave, pushing forward until they reach the enemy’s farm. Your barn is your only tower – and everything depends on how cleverly you choose, upgrade, and support your units.

Face ever-stronger enemies and their generals in thrilling boss battles. With every victory your chicks gain experience, level up, and unlock new abilities. Healing items, power-ups, and clever upgrades will help you hold the line – until your army becomes unstoppable and no foe can resist.

Hungry Chicks – Battle Farm combines elements of tower defense, action, and strategy into a unique gameplay experience: assemble your troops, use their special abilities, and lead your chicks to victory over the enemy’s base.

Fight with unique chicken units:
-Stable Guard: Defends your barn and hurls explosive egg bombs.
-Ninja: Fast melee fighters with swords who push the front line forward.
-Grenadier: Ranged fighters with multi-shot eggs, keeping enemies at a distance.
-Knight: Tough shield bearers that protect your troops from heavy attacks.
-Balloon: Bombards enemies from above and drops healing eggs to refresh your army.
-Sorcerer: Unleashes firestorms and makes defeated enemies explode spectacularly.

Dive into a unique world:
-Send your chicks from the barn and conquer the enemy’s base.
-Experience lovingly drawn comic-style graphics full of details and funny animations.
-Don’t be fooled by the rural idyll of mountains, windmills, and straw bales – the enemy knows no mercy!
-Fight through numerous levels with ever-new challenges.

Features:
🎮 6 unique classes with their own skills and abilities.
🐔 Dynamic units: your chicks rush forward on their own – no static placement!
🌟 Cartoon graphics with explosions, talking chickens, and charming effects.
🛡️ Strategic gameplay: choose your troops, upgrade them, and adapt to your opponent.
🔥 Boss battles against enemy generals.
⚡ Physics-based combat with moving units and objects.
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family-friendly – suitable for all ages, yet challenging to master.
🇩🇪 Made in Germany – fun, strategy, and humor in one package.


Thank You For Watching! You The Best!!
